test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 07 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown. Find the number on the face opposite the face showing '2'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f4a852958a9b6ad4f7b6e87fa2443ffb564b51a51178e14051b4978c0402ac82.png]
solution:
Taking dice position 1 and 2 with 2 as common.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5adf03f86295906af16e55b6cc6f924174a85203c0d944bcb47e6e5de905e38f.png] 

Moving clockwise from common number 2

pair of opposite numbers

3 - 4

5 - 6

**the number on the face opposite the face showing '2' is '1'**

Hence, the **correct answer** is **"Option 1".**
